account.note: Owns ID/passport switching and restores the separate typed values. Shared field formatting and routing remain central. Baseline Save changes/Cancel only navigate to settings; persistent saving, required-field enforcement and an audit trail are not implemented by this prototype.

articles.note: Owns feed rendering, search/filter, empty state and capture-phase card selection. Shared article data/store and update coordination remain central.

article.note: Owns article-detail rendering. kraneRenderArticle() reads window.kraneArticleState and shared editorial DOM helpers. Router retains the kraneArticleMock.renderDetail compatibility interface.

insurance-result.note: Result markup plus shared navigation; insurance confirmation belongs to pages/insurance/page.js.

appointment-booked.note: Owns appointment confirmation time activation; routing and appointment state are shared.

rx-writing.note: Owns count-up display, transition timer, exit/re-entry cleanup and next-view guard.

delivery-quote.note: Owns quote display, count-up and delayed transition. Shared fulfilment pricing/state remain central. Baseline exit guard prevents navigation; re-entry resets the timers.

payment-items.note: Interactive quantity controls reuse the reduce-only order handler shared with rx-plan; not a passive page.

pharmacypending.note: Owns stock-confirmation display and guarded return-to-checkout timer.

feedbackdone.note: Confirmation markup and generic navigation only; feedback modal is shared across clinical/order screens.

settings.note: Shared route links, localization selector and prototype toast actions. No separate settings service is implemented.

empty-activities.note: Empty-state markup and shared navigation only.

empty-history.note: Empty-state markup and shared navigation only.

upload-rx.note: Owns baseline file type/4 MB validation and browser-local clinical request submission. This behavior was already injected by the original external adapter; it is not a new upload feature. No production upload backend is provided.
